description: Eight generic user stories for a first test on a new product. They name features that most products with user accounts have. They are examples. They are not part of the evaluation of the thesis.

user_stories.title: User Login
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to log in to my account so I can use the product
acceptance_criteria: Users log in with a username and a password
Repeated failed logins are limited
Multi-factor authentication can be turned on
Sessions end after a time with no activity

user_stories.title: Password Reset
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to reset a forgotten password so I can get back into my account
acceptance_criteria: A reset link is sent to the email address of the account
The reset link expires
The new password must meet the password rules
Other sessions end after the reset

user_stories.title: Roles and Permissions
user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to give roles to users so each person has only the access they need
acceptance_criteria: Roles can be given to users and taken away
Each role has a set of permissions
Only admins can change roles
A role change applies immediately

user_stories.title: API Access Tokens
user_stories.story: As a developer, I want to create an access token so I can call the API from a script
acceptance_criteria: Tokens can be created and revoked
A token has a limited set of permissions
Tokens can expire
The token value is shown only once

user_stories.title: Single Sign-On
user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to connect the product to our identity provider so users sign in with their company account
acceptance_criteria: An identity provider can be configured
Users are matched to existing accounts
Local password login can be turned off
Users who are removed at the identity provider lose access

user_stories.title: File Uploads
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to upload files so I can share them with other users
acceptance_criteria: Files can be uploaded and downloaded
File type and file size are limited
Only users with access can open a file
Links to files can be turned off

user_stories.title: Audit Log
user_stories.story: As an admin, I want a log of important actions so I can find out who did what
acceptance_criteria: Logins and admin actions are recorded
Each entry has the user and the time
Only admins can read the log
Log entries cannot be changed

user_stories.title: Webhooks and Integrations
user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to connect the product to other services so work happens automatically
acceptance_criteria: Incoming and outgoing webhooks can be configured
Requests are checked with a secret or a token
An integration has only the permissions it needs
Integrations can be turned off
